name: exception_handler
purpose: Dispatch CPU exceptions to the optional game exception veneer or return from the exception
return: no scalar result; D0.w=0 on game dispatch

name: irq1_handler
purpose: Dispatch IRQ1 to game hook 0x4000C when installed

name: irq2_handler
purpose: Dispatch IRQ2 to game hook 0x40018 when installed

name: irq3_handler
purpose: Dispatch IRQ3 to game hook 0x40012 when installed

name: irq4_vblank_handler
purpose: Dispatch VBLANK to the OS handler or game hook, otherwise acknowledge it locally

name: irq6_handler
purpose: Dispatch self-test-mode IRQ6 to the game sound hook or consume/store the OS-lane sound response

name: selftest_boot
purpose: Start the full destructive test of video-RAM spare before the self-test boot continuation chain
exceptional_convention: early-boot tail entry; installs A4 continuation

name: reset_entry
purpose: Mask interrupts, pulse the board latch, delay while petting watchdog, and select normal or self-test boot

name: normal_boot
purpose: Seed color RAM and start the short destructive video-RAM-spare test for normal boot
exceptional_convention: early-boot tail entry; installs A4 continuation

name: main_init_cont
purpose: Initialize display/stack, validate OS and game ROM checksums plus EEPROM, clear OS RAM, and dispatch game or OS mode

name: display_working_ram_error
purpose: Write the fixed 'Working RAM error' message to diagnostic video memory

name: error_display_ram
purpose: Initialize alpha display and show detailed RAM-test failure values
arguments: D4.l=error class; A0=failing address; D0.w=expected; D1.w=actual
exceptional_convention: register wrapper that constructs four normal stack arguments

name: rom_checksum_display
purpose: Display OS-ROM checksum accumulators and identify failed even/odd byte lanes

name: os_vblank_mode_entry
purpose: Enable OS-owned VBLANK processing and enter the non-returning OS self-test loop
arguments: D5.w=mode value pushed as an unused long argument
exceptional_convention: register entry; its post-call cleanup/tail-JMP has no discovered returning predecessor

name: os_vblank_handler
purpose: Acknowledge VBLANK, update scroll/input/text/EEPROM state, and return from interrupt
exceptional_convention: interrupt entry; saves D0-D1/A0-A1 and RTE

name: display_ram_error_detail
purpose: Draw RAM region name, failing address, expected word, and actual word
arguments: error class/index; failing address; expected word; actual word
